messages:
Priya S.: Quick note — benchmark post and tech deep-dive are greenlit for publish tomorrow but partner wants a hard embargo at 10:30am PT. Need media ops + exec quote queued. Can marketing confirm we can hit that exact minute?
Kate R.: If partner insists on 10:30 hard embargo, we must freeze outreach until then. I can hold top-tier sends to 10:35. Who is confirming the exec quote?
Jonah C.: I can provide a short quote from Research if CEO is tied up. Prefer: 1 sentence on throughput gains + one on reliability.
Leo K.: I have a 10:00 call with LeadTech for a pre-brief — they asked for embargoed access. We should give them the preview doc but mark it very clearly.
Maria H.: Please use the internal preview link with watermark and add this line: "For embargoed review only — do not publish before 10:30 PT."
Kate R.: Draft embargo email to press (short):
``
Subject: Embargo: Redwood benchmark & deep-dive (10:30am PT)
Hi <reporter>,
Sharing an embargoed preview of our benchmark and technical deep-dive. Embargo lifts on [date] at 10:30am PT. Please do not publish before then. We'll send assets and a lift note at 10:30.
Best,
Kate (Redwood comms)
```
Priya S.: Adding internal checklist: update /launch/benchmarks doc, flag Sales Slack channel, post on internal #all-hands-notify 10:32, and schedule CDN cache flush at 10:31.
OpsBot: Automated: CDN purge queued for 2140000060 (10:31 PT). Reply 'confirm' to run immediate purge.
Leo K.: What about press embargo violation plan? If someone posts early, do we alert partner and hold?
Maria H.: Escalation plan: 1) DM reporter asking to hold, 2) notify partner/legal, 3) delay external syndication for 24h if needed. We'll lean on relationships first.
Jonah C.: Quote for review: "These results show consistent 2–4x throughput improvements across realistic prompt distributions, with latency preserved for interactive flows." Thoughts?
Kate R.: Good. Shorten to: "Benchmarks demonstrate consistent 2–4x throughput improvements while maintaining interactive latency." I'll add the partner attribution line when they send it.
Priya S.: Social copy (staggered):
``
At 10:30 PT: Embargo lift note + blog link.
At 10:45 PT: Thread breakdown + benchmark chart image.
At 11:00 PT: Partner case study highlight + CTO quote.
```
PressBot: Automated: Holds placed on social schedule IDs 80123, 80124, 80125.
Kate R.: Send me partner legal copy now. Partner insisted on exact phrase: "PartnerCo provided test workloads under non-disclosure."
Priya S.: I pasted the partner phrase into the internal doc and pinged them for confirmation.
OpsBot: Automated: Webhook to analytics queued (post-publish). Will run at 10:33 PT.
Leo K.: I'll offer LeadTech an alternate embargoed read at 9:50 PT w/ watermark.
Maria H.: All good. If partner confirms the legal line, I'll approve the blog and Kate can send the embargo email. Closing unless someone sees a blocker.
Kate R.: I'll wait for the legal copy then send.
Jonah C.: Confirmed on my end for the research quote.
Maria H.: ✅
